entities.summary: Haywood Lee Highsmith Jr. is an American professional basketball player for the Phoenix Suns of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Cardinals of Wheeling Jesuit University and was the NCAA Division II Player of the Year as a senior in 2018. Highsmith was born in Baltimore.
